name: Admin Accounting Expected Income Detail
description: Superuser clicks the 'Pendiente por cobrar · {mes}' stat card on /panel/accounting and a read-only modal opens with the company expected incomes of the real current month (GET /api/accounting/incomes/?kind=expected&ledger=company&date_from&date_to derived from expected_current_month.period, not the year selector). The table lists concepto, período, total, abonado (paid_amount), pendiente (pending_amount, per-row clamped) and payment status pill, with a footer whose Pendiente sum equals the card total. Cerrar closes the modal; no actions on rows.
